start: Fresh install, welcome screen, the 3 setup steps

steps.action: Type a name and a mobile number on step 1, tap Next
must_not: The name or number lost when the step changes

steps.action: Tap kg, then switch to WhatsApp to find the gym code; Android closes MettleUp
must_not: The answers kept only on screen

user_sees: The welcome opens on the same step with the name, number and kg already filled
must_not: The start view shown again with empty boxes

steps.action: Pick a goal and experience on step 3, tap Start training
must_not: The saved answers left behind after the profile is made

start: Welcome, the member picked Bring workouts, From Hevy, then the 3 steps

steps.action: Fill step 1, tap Next; Android closes the app
Open MettleUp again and finish the steps
user_sees: The same step with the answers kept, and 'Your Hevy workouts and routines come in right after you tap Start training.'
must_not: The Hevy import forgotten without a word after the restart

start: Welcome, the saved answers are damaged (a broken record on the phone)

user_sees: The welcome starts clean, with no error
must_not: A crash or an error screen
A goal or level the app does not know put into the boxes

start: Welcome, answers saved, then Start training fails once

user_sees: 'Could not save your details. Please try again.'
must_not: The saved answers cleared although no profile was made

user_sees: The app opens on the new profile
must_not: The answers offered again later on this phone

start: Welcome, name and mobile number typed, app closed

steps.action: Reopen and look at the boxes
user_sees: The same answers, kept on this phone only
must_not: The name or number sent to MettleUp or the gym before Start training
